verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS platform with an API reference (custom integration push APIs, Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. An API reference existing does not show versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
